defects: Quantifier order is reversed: the produced statement lets the bound M depend on x = Re(z) (∀x ∃M), whereas gold's IsBoundedAtImInfty requires a single bound uniform over all z (∃ bound, ∀ z with Im z large)

Produced statement requires the bound to hold for all y > 0, not just eventually as y → ∞; it thus asserts boundedness on the entire vertical line down to the real axis, rather than only near the cusp i∞ as the gold's filter-based (eventual) notion does

Because of the above two issues, the produced statement is not equivalent to 'bounded at the cusp i∞': it omits the eventual/asymptotic (Im z → ∞) character of IsBoundedAtImInfty and instead encodes a different, non-equivalent (and for E_2, actually false) boundedness claim
Does not use the standard IsBoundedAtImInfty/atImInfty filter formalism from the gold, instead reimplementing a bespoke condition that diverges from the intended meaning
